//ConnectionStrings: Password is NEVER committed. Supply it via `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:Default" "..."` or the ConnectionStrings__Default environment variable. See README.md.
//Anthropic: ApiKey comes from user-secrets or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. With no key the API falls back to the deterministic rule-based classifier and says so in every response.
//DuplicateDetection: Thresholds are config, not code, so they can be tuned live during the demo without a rebuild.
//Cors: Empty = allow any origin (needed for Expo Go on a LAN during the hackathon). Deployments should list explicit origins.
